high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "motherboardvice." The post is titled "America's two decade long war in Afghanistan is over." The content of the post discusses the fall of Kabul to the Taliban, the departure of President Ashraf Ghani, and the evacuation of American allies and personnel from Kabul airport. The text elaborates on the speed at which the U.S.-backed Afghan government fell, suggesting that it was shocking for those who were not aware of the U.S. government's own reports documenting the failures of its reconstruction efforts in Afghanistan.
